pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **Rafe's draft strategy was as intellectually bankrupt as his points total.** Look, as someone who's put on the national team jersey, I can't help but find "The Noisemaker" Rafe's choices as laughable to say the least. Germany? Fine, but Ecuador, Mexico, Tunisia, and Scotland? Did he just line up CONCACAF teams he remembered from FIFA 23? At this point, Rafe isn't just last — he's a case study in what not to do. Gunner, or "Bubba G," gives the rest of you a soccer clinic, topping the standings with 81 points, a whopping 23-point lead over his nearest rival, Devin. And Mustard Boy, Zach, don't think you're off the hook; your love affair with mid-tier teams like Switzerland and Austria put you firmly in third with a lackluster 43 points. As for "The Backpass Assassin," Gayden, stick to passing backward because your 39 points say you don’t know forward momentum if it hit you in the face. If you amateurs want to learn something, give Gunner a call. Or, better yet, maybe just watch my highlight reels — you'd play the game better just by osmosis.
